---
name: Feature Request / Sugestão de Recurso
about: Suggest a new idea, language feature, or kernel optimization
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ''
---

## Summary / Resumo
A concise summary of the proposed feature. / Resumo da melhoria proposta.

## Motivation & Use Case / Motivação e Caso de Uso
Why is this needed and what problem does it solve? / Por que isso é importante e qual problema resolve?

## Proposed Implementation / Proposta de Implementação
How do you envision this being implemented? (syntax, kernel design, C99 emission, etc.)

## Alternatives Considered / Alternativas Consideradas
Any alternative approaches or trade-offs considered.
